<description>
**Problem:** Full chainstate compaction can temporarily require nearly another copy of the database before old files are deleted.

**Fix:** Log automatic compaction start and finish at info level and warn beforehand if the chainstate filesystem has less free space than `AssumedChainStateSize()`. Compaction continues after the warning because postponing cleanup would allow obsolete data to accumulate. Also document the temporary disk-space requirement and add a release note.

Fixes #36585
</description>

<commits>
19b1126d5d logging: show automatic chainstate compaction

Automatic chainstate compaction can use substantial disk space and take minutes, but its start and finish are hidden unless `-debug=coindb` is enabled.
Log both by default so operators can identify the cause of sudden changes in disk usage.

99409eec3b coins: warn of low disk space before compaction

Full chainstate compaction can temporarily write nearly another copy of the database before deleting its input tables.
Warn before starting if the chainstate filesystem has less free space than the chain's `AssumedChainStateSize()`.
Continue compaction after the warning because postponing cleanup would let obsolete data accumulate.

22ae900d3a doc: explain chainstate compaction disk usage
</commits>
